_comment: What every shipped mobile artifact MUST structurally contain. Read by scripts/verify-mobile-artifact.mjs, which gates submission on it. Adding a required key here is how a new native capability becomes un-forgettable — builds 34, 38 and 39 each shipped missing something on this list before it existed.

android._permissionsComment: Android-only permissions are declared in patch-android-release.mjs step 4b, NOT in app.json — app.json is hashed as a whole, so a one-sided key moves the OTHER platform's fingerprint (measured 2026-08-25: READ_EXERCISE alone shut the iOS channel off build 60). That rehoming moves the declaration into gitignored prebuild output, where nothing else checks it — which is exactly why it is listed here.
